name: encantar
description: GPU-accelerated Augmented Reality library for the web
author: Alexandre Martins <alemartf@gmail.com> (https://github.com/alemart)

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run dev
scripts.prebuild: echo 'Building encantar...' && tsc --noEmit && npm run clean
scripts.build: npm run build-core && npm run build-types && npm run build-plugins && npm run build-addons
scripts.build-core: npm run build-core-iife && npm run build-core-esm
scripts.build-core-iife: node build.mjs core iife && node build.mjs core iife --minify
scripts.build-core-esm: node build.mjs core esm && node build.mjs core esm --minify
scripts.build-types: shx mkdir -p dist && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --isolatedModules false --declaration --outFile dist/encantar.d.ts
scripts.build-plugins: node build.mjs plugins && node build.mjs plugins --minify
scripts.build-addons: node build.mjs addons && node build.mjs addons --minify
